description: Korean workplace size and schedule check (근로기준법): mode count = regular headcount from daily worker counts over the past month (시행령 제7조의2 average plus the half-of-days rule) against 5 / 10 / 30 thresholds; mode schedule = a weekly shift list checked for daily 8 h / weekly 40 h, overtime cap 12 h (minors 7/35/5), breaks (30 min per 4 h, 1 h per 8 h), night hours 22-06, weekly paid holiday and the 15-hour weekly-holiday-pay line. Small (<5) workplaces skip overtime caps and premiums.

daily.description: count: workers on each operating day (exclude dispatched workers)
